args.command: systemctl disable --now zen-mini-chrome.service 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -u zenui -f '/opt/google/chrome/chrome|google-chrome' 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1; echo '=== chrome service ==='; systemctl is-enabled zen-mini-chrome.service 2>/dev/null || true; systemctl is-active zen-mini-chrome.service 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== chrome process ==='; pgrep -a -u zenui -f '/opt/google/chrome/chrome|google-chrome' || true; echo '=== taskbar ==='; systemctl is-active zen-mini-taskbar.service 2>/dev/null || true; chvt 3 2>/dev/null || true

meta.summary: Disable always-on Chrome so user can close it normally while keeping browser handoff on demand
